description:
Some tasks shouldn't be interrupted — a download at 92%, a render at 3 a.m., a deck mid-presentation. Americano keeps your Mac awake for exactly as long as you need it to.

It lives quietly in your menu bar. Right-click the little cup and your Mac stays awake; right-click again and it can sleep. Left-click when you want to choose how long — five minutes, three hours, or simply "until I say so."

A few things it does well:

• Flexible durations — five minutes to indefinite, with a sleep timer and presets of your own
• Battery aware — pauses when you're low, unplugged, or in Low Power Mode
• Display control — prevent display sleep, or let the screen rest while your Mac keeps working
• Set and forget — launch at login, activate on launch, screen saver when finished
• Quietly private — no accounts, no analytics, no data collected

A native, sandbox-friendly take on caffeinate — no terminal required. Small, strong, and exactly to the point — like the coffee it's named after, and the caffeine in it.
